name: National MILO Marathon 2026 – General Santos City Leg
short_description: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – General Santos City Leg is a half-marathon and multi-distance race set for August 9, 2026 in General Santos City, Philippines.
ai_summary: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – General Santos City Leg is a race scheduled for August 9, 2026, held in General Santos City, Philippines. Organized by RUNRIO Inc. under the MILO Marathon banner, the event offers four distance options: 21.1km, 10km, 5km, and 3km. Registration has not yet been confirmed as open, so prospective participants should watch for further announcements.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km, 3km) suit a range of runner abilities
Organized by RUNRIO Inc., the established organizer behind the MILO Marathon series
Set in General Santos City, giving local and traveling runners a Mindanao race option
cons: Registration status is not yet confirmed as open, so details for signing up are unavailable

excerpt_quotes.quote: I am very pleased with my win. The route was good. I set my pace with the male runners during the entire race
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Liza Ambasa (21K winner), quoted in MILO Marathon news release, Kalongkong Hiker

research_highlights: The General Santos leg is part of the 2026 National MILO Marathon's 50th anniversary ('The Golden Run') calendar, one of 15 legs nationwide with the National Finals in Clark City, Pampanga on December 6.
Distances offered at the GenSan leg are 3K, 5K, 10K and 21K, with a listed evening flag-off around 6:05pm.
Per official 2024 race mechanics from RUNRIO, category cut-off times are 6 hours for the 42.195K, 2.5 hours for the 21K and 1.5 hours for the 10K, counted from each category's own start.
Runners must secure a signed 'Fit-To-Run' medical certificate within two months of race day to join the 21K/42K categories, per the official rules.
The GenSan leg has historically been one of the larger provincial legs — the 2014 edition drew over 9,300 runners, described at the time as the biggest race in General Santos City to date.

faqs.question: When is the National MILO Marathon 2026 – General Santos City Leg scheduled?
faqs.answer: The race is scheduled for August 9, 2026. It will take place in General Santos City, Philippines, as one of the legs of the National MILO Marathon series organized by RUNRIO Inc. No further scheduling details beyond this date have been confirmed yet.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from four distance categories: 21.1km (half-marathon), 10km, 5km, and 3km. The 21.1km half-marathon serves as the primary distance for this leg of the National MILO Marathon, while the shorter distances offer options for less experienced or casual runners.

faqs.question: Who organizes the National MILO Marathon 2026 General Santos City Leg?
faqs.answer: This race is organized by RUNRIO Inc., the group behind the MILO Marathon series held across the Philippines. The General Santos City Leg is one stop within this broader national race series taking place in 2026.

faqs.question: Is registration currently open for this race?
faqs.answer: Registration for the National MILO Marathon 2026 – General Santos City Leg is not yet confirmed as open. Prospective participants should check back for updates, as no official registration opening date or process has been announced at this time.
